changeSet.author: campaign-platform
changeSet.comment: Insert the five default marketing channels: EMAIL, SMS, SOCIAL, PUSH, DISPLAY
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.channel (name, type, description) VALUES ('Email', 'EMAIL', 'Email marketing campaigns'), ('SMS', 'SMS', 'SMS / text message campaigns'), ('Social Media', 'SOCIAL', 'Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, etc.'), ('Push Notification', 'PUSH', 'Mobile and web push notifications'), ('Display Ads', 'DISPLAY', 'Banner and display advertising');

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM public.channel WHERE name IN ('Email', 'SMS', 'Social Media', 'Push Notification', 'Display Ads');
